text:
maria: FYI support ticket from BigRetail — sudden p95/p99 spike for their Dedicated pool (pool: equinox-prod) starting ~10:15 UTC. They report client timeouts and queued requests.

support-bot: Ticket #BR-4482 escalated by @tess at 10:22 UTC — customer seeing 5xx and high tail latency, attached traces.

maria: Their graphs: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~950ms, p99 to ~4.8s. Throughput didn't rise much. Looks like requests are queueing before attach.

rajesh: Can you paste the promQL for pending attach queue? I want to see queue size vs time.

maria: PromQL we used: ```promql
sum(rate(dedicated_pool_pending_attaches_total{pool="equinox-prod"}[1m])) by (pool)
```
Time series shows a burst of ~220 pending attaches at 10:14-10:18.

jordan: Also saw a bunch of `gpu_warmup_timeout` entries in logs around then: ```text
2026-03-15T10:16:12Z WARN warmup: instance i-0abc... timed out after 45s
```

tess: Customer says they sent a traffic spike (marketing send). They were expecting autoscale to handle it. They got 504s from our API and started retrying — probably added more pressure.

mike: Root cause candidate: thundering-burst caused new instance warmup to slow down and the attach queue overflowed, which increased attach latency p95/p99.

rajesh: Agreed. Quick mitigation options: 1) route BigRetail to hosted routing pool temporarily, 2) manually add 4 GPUs to equinox-prod, 3) increase pool min for enterprise accounts. Which is fastest?

maria: I can add GPUs to the pool now (manual attach). Doing manual scale: `infractl pool resize equinox-prod --add-gpus 4`

infra-bot: Running action `pool-resize` with request id r-9f1. ETA for attach 35-65s per instance (depends on warmup).

rajesh: While that's happening, let's also flip a transient routing rule to send BigRetail traffic to hosted-api to avoid further queueing. @tess can you confirm customer allows traffic diversion?

tess: Confirmed — customer agreed to temporary routing for 30m. Doing DNS rule now: `rb-route set --customer bigretail --target hosted-us-west`

maria: Manual pool resize done, infra shows 4 new GPUs requested. Warmup logs: `warmup started` -> `kv-cache priming` -> then some timeouts. We need to prime the cache to avoid cold-KV penalties. I pushed a warmup job: `scripts/warmup_pump --pool equinox-prod --concurrency 8 --seq 512`.

jordan: P95 dropped to ~180ms after routing flip + warmup pump. P99 still ~900ms but trending down.

support-bot: Customer updated: errors stopped after 10:40 UTC on their side, but they want postmortem and long-term fix.

mike: Postmortem items (short): 
- Repro: Simulate burst of 2k concurrent sessions to equinox-prod using `loadtest/attach-burst.sh` (curl + header X-Customer=bigretail).
- Immediate mitigations that helped: manual pool add, route-to-hosted, warmup pump.
- Root causes: autoscaler reactive thresholds too tight; warmup time > autoscale window; no pre-provision buffer for enterprise customers.

rajesh: Long-term action items: 
1) Add `min_reserved_gpus` per-enterprise-plan metadata and honor it in autoscaler.
2) Increase attach/scale-window to account for GPU warmup variance or randomize attach start to avoid thundering herd.
3) Implement KV priming as part of warmup lifecycle to reduce post-attach tail latency.
4) Add alert: `dedicated_pool_pending_attaches > 50 for 2m` -> page eng-sre.

mike: I'll open the postmortem and link dashboards, assign owners. @rajesh take 1) and 3). @tess take customer comms and confirm SLAs. @jordan add warmup instrumentation.

tess: Will send customer a timeline + mitigations, ask about ordering a reserved burst for holiday windows.

maria: Notes for the postmortem: include PromQL snippets, warmup logs, and the exact `infractl` commands we ran. Example PromQL to show queue vs attach rate: ```promql
sum(dedicated_pool_pending_attaches{pool="equinox-prod"})
/
sum(rate(dedicated_pool_attach_success_total{pool="equinox-prod"}[30s]))
```

rajesh: Also found a small bug in attach backoff that causes retries to bunch up at certain error codes — created GH issue #RR-964.

mike: OK wrapping up — short follow-ups: we keep the host routing for 30m, remove if stable for 15m, and prepare postmortem draft by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket #BR-4482 updated with mitigation steps and PM link: https://pm.internal/bigretail-br-4482

maria: Closing the oncall thread, will reopen if metrics regress.
